description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/upwind1_D_inflow_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the plain D(u,x) replaced by the rule's makearray (imported backward stencil aggregate over [2,8]; inflow face at i=1 carrying the free names gL and dx), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
